explanation: The pieces are called tesserae. Byzantine artists sealed gold leaf inside some glass tesserae, so church mosaics such as those in Ravenna glitter in candlelight.

claims.text: A mosaic is an image or pattern made from small pieces of material such as stone, glass or tile.
Mosaics are not made from woven threads, painted canvas or pressed flowers.
The small pieces in a mosaic are called tesserae.
Byzantine mosaicists made gold tesserae by sealing gold leaf inside glass, as in the mosaics of Ravenna.
